briefs.claim_en: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, which caused an increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G was installed.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources, including the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) on April 22, 2020, and GOV.UK on May 6, 2020, state there is no scientific basis or evidence linking 5G technology to COVID-19. They explain that viruses cannot travel on radio waves and that COVID-19 spread in countries without 5G. Fact-checking organizations like AFP Fact Check (April 7, 2020) and Full Fact (March 31, 2020) have rated these claims as false. However, a study published in Medical Research Archives on April 12, 2021, found a statistically significant increase in COVID-19 cases and deaths in U.S. states and counties with 5G millimeter wave technology.
